title: Things to say instead of "calm down"

slides.title: Things to say instead of *“calm down”*
slides.sub: Small swaps that end arguments faster.

slides.new: “I can see this *really matters* to you.”
“I’m not okay yet, *but I want to be.*”
“It’s a big deal to you, *so it matters to me.*”

slides.title: Save this *for the next heated moment.*
slides.sub: Then send it to the one who still says “whatever.”
